newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan bolivar firms for second straight day.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan bolivar firms for second straight day.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar firmed for the second straight day closing at 472.50/473.50 as the Central Bank sold dollars into a quiet market, traders said.
The unit closed Thursday at 472.75/474.00 per dollar.
"It was basically a calm day," said one trader. "But Central Bank intervention, combined with dollar sales by foreign banks, firmed the bolivar," he added.
Traders saw the exchange rate firming again Friday. "It's very likely if this pattern of strong bolivar demand and continuing dollar sales carries on," said one at a large bank.
